fetch.ByEmailInvestigador: SELECT * FROM participa WHERE email_investigador=$1::text ORDER BY codigo_proyecto
fetch.ByCodigo: SELECT * FROM participa WHERE codigo_proyecto=$1::text ORDER BY email_investigador
fetch.ByCodigoAndEmail: SELECT * FROM participa WHERE codigo_proyecto=$1::text AND email_investigador=$2::text ORDER BY nombre_autor
fetch.NombreDeAutor: SELECT DISTINCT nombre_autor, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY nombre_autor) AS repetitions FROM participa WHERE email_investigador=$1::text ORDER BY repetitions

Create: INSERT INTO participa (email_investigador, codigo_proyecto, nombre_autor) VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text)

delete.ByPK: DELETE FROM participa WHERE codigo_proyecto=$1::text AND email_investigador=$2::text

add.Duplicated: There is already a participation for that proyecto with that investigador
add.Investigador: There doesn't exist any investigador with that email
add.Proyecto: There doesn't exist any proyecto with that code
